name: Hyrule's Collection (QoL & Cheats)
author: HyruleChosenOne
tagline: Offline Mode events hub, live main menu customization, P2P multiplayer, experimental Co-op Expeditions, solo cheats, and full profile unlocks.
description: All-in-one Offline Mode Quality-of-Life, Enablers, and Trainer Cheats collection by HyruleChosenOne. Restores past seasonal events in a dedicated Choose-Mode hub, unlocks direct IP:Port P2P Co-op multiplayer with Local Lobbies browser and an experimental Co-op Expeditions (2-4P) mode integrated into Co-op menus, adds live 3D main menu diorama and music selectors, and provides reworked Solo Combat Cheats (Run Speed 1x-3x, God Mode, Overdrive, Turbo XP, Super Magnet & Luck, Instant Ultimate), Unlock All Clan & Rank Rewards, Unlock All (Full Profile Customization), Max Friendship, Complete Quests, and Trainer Save Utilities.
highlights: Events Enabler restoring Lavender Tower Night and Mewtwo Strikes Back in a dedicated hub
Direct IP:Port Peer-to-Peer Co-op multiplayer with UDP Local Lobbies browser & 1-click Mod Sync
Experimental Co-op Expeditions (2-4P) toggle adding Expedition mode directly to Co-op menus with synced Expedition Base transitions for all players
Live 3D Main Menu Wallpaper and Music selector (supports additive custom music)
Solo Combat Cheats: Run Speed 1x/1.5x/2x/3x, God Mode, Overdrive, Turbo XP (5x), Super Magnet & Luck, Instant Ultimate, Unlock All Difficulties
Full Unlocks: Unlock All (Full Profile Customization), Unlock All Clan & Rank Rewards, Unlock All Wardrobe & Shinies, Max Friendship (Lv. 20), Complete All Quests

changes: Added Enable Solo Cheats (Pause Menu Access) toggle in Live Cheats so active live cheats can be adjusted directly inside the in-game Pause Menu during solo runs with no HUD while playing.
Added embedded collapsible support for the updated Mods Config layout across Desktop, Android, and iOS.

Integrated Co-op Expeditions (2-4P) as an Experimental toggle inside Hyrule's Collection (Core tab) with optional solo host launch, optional gear risk requirement, and +30s/+60s squad extraction regroup grace windows.

Added Expedition directly to the Co-op lobby Mode selector; selecting it seamlessly switches every player's UI into the full synced Co-op Expedition Base with every vanilla solo loadout, shop, refuge, route card, and wishlist option.
Moved Hyrule's Collection settings UI into its own modular config panel (config/panel.js) dynamically mounted inside Mods Config.
Verified full compatibility with PokéBonk v0.10.36 including P2P Co-op Expedition relay support and services-*.js error handling.
Added Unlock All (Full Profile Customization) covering icons, titles, frames, backgrounds, wardrobe skins, and Treasure wheels.
Added Unlock All Clan & Rank Rewards, Max Friendship (Lv. 20), and Complete All Quests save utilities.
Added direct IP:Port P2P Co-op Multiplayer with automatic UDP LAN Discovery and 1-click Co-op Mod Parity checks.
Reworked Solo Combat Cheats (Run Speed 1x-3x, God Mode, Overdrive, Turbo XP, Super Magnet & Luck, Instant Ultimate).

preservedVersions.note: Preserved release for PokéBonk Unbound v1.0.5 (Offline PokéBonk v0.10.31).
